description: This file defines the CaptureNode class within the Twig templating engine. The class represents a node that captures output content during template rendering, providing methods to compile this behavior into executable PHP code.

classes.name: CaptureNode
classes.description: Represents a node in Twig templates that captures the output of its child nodes, allowing the captured content to be used later in the template.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CaptureNode with a body node and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to capture the output of its body node during template rendering.
